Independence Date: 'Approx Years of British Rule' has no single correct value; the basis used is given in the adjacent column. India shows 190 yrs from Plassey (1757) but direct Crown rule was 89 yrs (1858-1947). Barbados (339 yrs, unbroken from 1627) is the most solid figure.

Independence was often staged. Canada is dated 1867 but was not fully sovereign until 1931 and could not amend its own constitution until 1982. Egypt's 1922 declaration left Britain in the Suez Canal Zone until 1956.
'Still a Commonwealth Realm' means King Charles III remains head of state. 14 former colonies qualify (15 realms including the UK). Barbados was the most recent to leave, on 30 November 2021.
'Violence or Bloodshed' is scored on the transfer itself and the decade around it, not the whole colonial period. A 'No' means the handover was orderly, not that British rule was peaceful.

Edge cases included: Bangladesh (seceded from Pakistan, not Britain); Samoa and Nauru (New Zealand and Australian administration under League of Nations mandate); Libya (British and French military administration under UN trusteeship); Oman (never formally a colony).
Excluded: Nepal and Bhutan (never annexed); Hong Kong (transferred to China 1 July 1997, not made independent); the 14 remaining British Overseas Territories; Northern Ireland.
